scenarios.title: Initial Application Load
scenarios.action: Inspect window.TrafficApp and initial state
scenarios.expected: TrafficApp initialized, FSM in S0_NS_GREEN, simStatus is STOPPED
scenarios.actual: State: S0_NS_GREEN, Status: STOPPED, App: true

scenarios.title: Start Normal Simulation
scenarios.action: Click Start / startSimulation()
scenarios.expected: simStatus transitions to RUNNING, countdown active

scenarios.title: Four Complete FSM Cycles
scenarios.action: Step simulation through 16 state transitions (4 full cycles)
scenarios.expected: FSM advances cyclicly through S0->S1->S2->S3->S0 with zero invariant violations
scenarios.actual: Completed 16 transitions across 4 full cycles. Final state: S0_NS_GREEN

scenarios.title: Pause & Resume During Green
scenarios.action: Pause simulation, check timer freeze, then resume
scenarios.expected: Simulation pauses (timer frozen), resumes correctly

scenarios.title: Pause & Resume During Yellow
scenarios.action: Pause simulation during yellow clearance, resume
scenarios.expected: Timer freezes during yellow clearance, resumes correctly
scenarios.actual: Paused in Yellow: PAUSED, Resumed: RUNNING

scenarios.title: Reset During Moving Traffic
scenarios.action: Call resetSimulation()
scenarios.expected: State resets to S0_NS_GREEN, vehicles cleared, counters reset
scenarios.actual: State: S0_NS_GREEN, Status: STOPPED, Active vehicles: 0

scenarios.title: Change Speed While Running
scenarios.action: Set speed multiplier to 2x and 0.5x
scenarios.expected: Multiplier updates dynamically without crashing loop

scenarios.title: Change Traffic Density While Running
scenarios.action: Switch density mode to HIGH, then LOW
scenarios.expected: Density updates and spawn intervals scale accordingly
scenarios.actual: High mode: HIGH, Low mode: LOW

scenarios.title: Switch Timing Modes
scenarios.action: Cycle through FIXED, MANUAL, and ADAPTIVE
scenarios.expected: Active timing mode switches cleanly with synced XAI rationales
scenarios.actual: Fixed: FIXED, Manual: MANUAL, Restored: ADAPTIVE

scenarios.title: High North-South Demand
scenarios.action: Simulate heavy NS queue (11 demand) vs empty EW
scenarios.expected: Green duration scales up towards MAX_GREEN (25s) with Congestion rationale

scenarios.title: High East-West Demand
scenarios.action: Simulate heavy EW queue (12 demand) vs empty NS
scenarios.expected: Green duration scales up towards MAX_GREEN (25s) for EW green

scenarios.title: Empty Traffic Demand
scenarios.action: Simulate zero queues across all 4 corridors
scenarios.expected: Allocates nominal base duration (10s) with Low congestion

scenarios.title: Dispatch Ambulance All Directions
scenarios.action: Dispatch AMBULANCE on North, South, East, West
scenarios.expected: All 4 dispatches spawn correctly with isEmergency=true, type=AMBULANCE

scenarios.title: Dispatch Fire Engine All Directions
scenarios.action: Dispatch FIRE_ENGINE on North, South, East, West
scenarios.expected: All 4 dispatches spawn correctly with isEmergency=true, type=FIRE_ENGINE

scenarios.title: Dispatch Police All Directions
scenarios.action: Dispatch POLICE on North, South, East, West
scenarios.expected: All 4 dispatches spawn correctly with isEmergency=true, type=POLICE

scenarios.title: Emergency Dispatch During Opposing Green
scenarios.action: Dispatch ambulance on North (opposing corridor)
scenarios.expected: FSM triggers safe yellow transition (S3) before green preemption

scenarios.title: Emergency Dispatch During Yellow Clearance
scenarios.action: Dispatch ambulance on East corridor
scenarios.expected: Maintains yellow clearance inviolability, preemption queues for next green

scenarios.title: Multiple Emergency Vehicles
scenarios.action: Queue second emergency vehicle on East
scenarios.expected: Active request retains priority, second request queued without corruption
scenarios.actual: Target switched to latest request: east

scenarios.title: Priority Hold While Approaching
scenarios.action: Inspect Priority Hold logic circuit
scenarios.expected: PriorityHold output is HIGH (1), corridor matches target

scenarios.title: Priority Hold Inside Junction Box
scenarios.initial: Vehicle at pos=220px (past stop line, in conflict zone)
scenarios.action: Inspect Priority Hold logic circuit
scenarios.expected: PriorityHold output remains strictly HIGH (1)

scenarios.title: Automatic Priority Release at Exit
scenarios.action: Clear emergency priority and inspect circuit
scenarios.expected: cleared=1, PriorityHold output releases to 0

scenarios.title: All-Red Halt with Empty Intersection
scenarios.action: Trigger toggleAllRedHalt()
scenarios.expected: All 4 signal directions forced to RED, FSM in EMERGENCY_ALL_RED

scenarios.title: All-Red Halt with Occupied Intersection
scenarios.initial: In All-Red with vehicle queued before stop line
scenarios.action: Step vehicle towards stop line
scenarios.expected: Vehicle halts completely before stop line (138px) with speed 0px/s

scenarios.title: Recover from All-Red Halt
scenarios.action: Toggle All-Red Halt to resume
scenarios.expected: Resumes to safe pre-halt state (S0_NS_GREEN)
scenarios.actual: Recovered state: S0_NS_GREEN, North signal: GREEN

scenarios.title: Reset All Analytics
scenarios.action: Call resetSimulation()
scenarios.expected: Generated=0, Passed=0, WaitTime=0, Active=0

scenarios.title: Run High-Density Traffic
scenarios.action: Step 20 seconds of high density traffic
scenarios.expected: Vehicles spawn, queue collision-free without deadlocks

scenarios.title: Use All Seven Learning Gates
scenarios.action: Select AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR, XNOR
scenarios.expected: Each gate updates formula, truth table, and outputs correctly

scenarios.title: Verify Truth Table Highlighting
scenarios.action: Set Input A=1, B=1
scenarios.expected: Active row in truth table matches (1, 1 -> 0)

scenarios.title: Verify Live Controller Circuits
scenarios.action: Select all 6 controller circuits sequentially
scenarios.expected: Circuit selection, SVG schematics, and subterms update without error

scenarios.title: Switch Modes While Simulation Running
scenarios.action: Switch between LIVE and LEARNING modes
scenarios.expected: Containers toggle smoothly, simulation continues without side-effects
scenarios.actual: Toggled to LEARNING, then returned to LIVE

scenarios.title: Dashboard Metric Consistency
scenarios.action: Verify conservation and DOM synchronization
scenarios.expected: Total Generated = Total Passed + Active Vehicles

scenarios.title: Zero JavaScript Runtime Errors
scenarios.action: Inspect CDP captured console error logs
scenarios.expected: Zero runtime exceptions and zero console errors
